name: Charlotte
source:
Favorite undies: Cute
Favorite season: Summer
Hobby: Basketball
Favorite color: Blue

Charlotte is a shy young woman. She recently suffered a heartbreak and is looking for a job to take her mind off it.

Charlotte enjoys playing basketball and used to be a center in her college team.

Now looking to meet new people and find something new, she walks into the shop looking for a job.
